messages:
lena_cs: Quick thread to track AuroraEdge's new onboarding ask-- they want a gated private 13B with PHI suppression, EU data residency, and a deterministic eval they can run locally before pilot sign-off.
arjun_se: Noted. Did a fast compat check; model loads and KV cache looks fine. We'll need to pin the quantization profile to int4 and keep fp16 cache to hit their accuracy bar.
dr_patel_aurora: Important: we cannot have any outbound telemetry for the pilot, and HSM key control must be under our admins. Also want an SRE-runbook for scaled failover.
toby_ml: Safety plan draft: 1) PHI redaction stress (n=2k) 2) Role-based prompt injection tests 3) Regression vs their reference baseline (n=500). Pass thresholds: PHI-leakage < 0.25%, hallucination rate < 0.5%.
rachel_sec: Security ops: HSM connector requires a private subnet deployment and their infra to sign connector access. We can support per-tenant no-retention policy and 30-day encrypted audit logs to their KMS.
lena_cs: Renewal note: Aurora said pilot SLA filters renewal. If median latency > 120ms or PHI-leakage > threshold, they reserve right to renegotiate capacity. Flagging renewal-risk-medium-high and notifying AE.
dr_patel_aurora: Can we get a one-command eval binary? Our infra team wants something repeatable for their CI.
arjun_se: We'll provide an eval runner binary. Example usage:
```
./aurora_eval --endpoint https://private.redwood/aurora-13b --suite eu_phi_suite.json --seed 7 --out aurora_report.json
```
This runs under deterministic seeding mode for reproducible results.
toby_ml: I'll drop the suite artifacts into their shared bucket and include a small sample of adversarial prompts. Expect initial numbers within 36 hours.
rachel_sec: Action: I'll post the HSM connector checklist and the minimal VPC diagram they need to approve by EOD tomorrow.
arjun_se: Config snippet we'll use for tenant policy:
```
{"tenant": "auroraedge", "deploy_mode": "private", "region": "eu-west-1", "hsm": true, "no_token_logging": true, "fallback": "hosted-eu-13b"}
```
lena_cs: We're scheduling a 45-min enablement + runbook review the week before pilot. @dr_patel_aurora what days work for your infra/SRE?
dr_patel_aurora: Prefer Tue/Wed mornings (CEST). Also need the failover runbook entries they requested: how to switch to hosted variant and what audit items are captured.
arjun_se: We'll build the failover playbook (automated switch + manual rollback) and include the audit stream mapping. Fallback will emit a tenant-level event but not token-level contents.
deploy-bot: private deploy for aurora-13b scheduled at 2026-04-12T10:20:14Z logs: https://deploys.redwood/private/1799999999
lena_cs: Thanks all I'll capture decisions in CRM and set renewal flag. Keeping this thread as canonical onboarding tracker and enablement coordination.
